description: Save one real entry in the user's Library Journal when they ask to save or create a journal entry or travel memory. This is NOT a trip NoteSegment: never substitute a note categorized Journal or claim a journal was saved without this tool succeeding. Use the user's text or, when requested, a factual summary of retrieved trip events. Do not invent attendance, experiences or feelings from itinerary plans. Use dates supplied or established by the user; ask when the date or source is unclear. An explicit create/save request authorizes this private additive save without another confirmation; a request to draft text alone does not. Entries are private and excluded from shared travel books; linking a trip does not share the entry. Generate a new clientId UUID once per entry and reuse the exact UUID and content on retries. On success use the returned entryUrl to open the actual saved entry. On errors do not claim success or silently switch to another storage type.

clientId.description: New UUID for this entry. Reuse unchanged on a transport retry.

entryDate.description: Journal date, YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve relative dates from the user's context; ask if unclear.

story.description: Preserve the user's own account. When summarizing retrieved itinerary events, describe them neutrally as booked or scheduled plans, even for past dates. A booking is not evidence the user attended. Never write that the user or 'we' attended, visited, enjoyed, watched, joined or experienced something unless the user supplied that fact. Do not invent feelings or sensory details.

title.description: A concise title from the user's text or requested factual event summary.

tripId.description: Optional exact accessible trip ID. Null saves without a trip.
